verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation (such as watch folders or hot-folder rules) is a fair question for an image-processing tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a scripting-first CLI for batch jobs and language bindings. These are developer building blocks or user-side scripting workarounds, not a documented rules engine or event triggers in the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
